have : (n * n + n) % 2 = 0 :=
  by
    cases n with n
    constructor
    · rw [Nat.even_iff]
      exact Nat.even_mul_even n n
    · rw [Nat.even_iff]
      have : (n + 1) % 2 = 0 := by rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_two_eq] <;> exact Nat.mod_two_eq_one n
      rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_two_eq] at this
      exact Nat.even_add_even n this
